text:
Hannah Lee: Heads up — CloudEdge (third-party CDN) cache appears to be returning 200 to clients for some embed requests without forwarding to origin. Customer ClearSight reports 330k client-successes for Jun 12 but our ingestion export shows 278k.
Victor Ramos: interesting. CDN would mean client thinks it's processed but we never saw the hit. Do we have sample client req_ids and timestamps?
Hannah Lee: client provided sample IDs: CS-req-991..CS-req-995 and timestamps around 2026-06-12T14:22Z. They show local success, we have no corresponding ingest lines. sample client-side: 
```
2026-06-12T14:22:01Z CLIENT req_id=CS-req-991 status=200 duration=120ms
2026-06-12T14:22:02Z CLIENT req_id=CS-req-992 status=200 duration=110ms
```
Victor Ramos: checked our origin logs — no entries for those req_ids. But edge logs from CDN show cache_hit for those paths: 
```
2026-06-12T14:22:01Z EDGE cache_hit path=/v1/embeddings customer=clearsight req_id=CS-req-991
2026-06-12T14:22:02Z EDGE cache_hit path=/v1/embeddings customer=clearsight req_id=CS-req-992
```
Priya Singh: so CDN returned cached 200s and client counts them. Are cached responses billable? Our billing counts origin ingestion only. This could produce client-reported > billed.
Alejandra (Revenue Ops): what's the financial exposure? ClearSight is on enterprise committed plan but this is concerning for trust. I can approve provisional credit up to $300 while we reconcile.
Victor Ramos: ballpark delta ~52k requests => at embed price $0.0006 = ~$31.2; but if token mix differs could be higher. We need to reconcile with CDN logs and origin to compute "edge-served" count.
EdgeCDN Ops Bot: EdgeCDN incident 2459: config 'cache-200-responses' enabled for /v1/embeddings for performance. Rule returns cached 200 when TTL valid. Origin see_count is not incremented on cache_hit.
Hannah Lee: Ops plan: (1) request full edge log dump for Jun 12 window (2) join edge logs with origin ingest by req_id and path (3) compute edge_only_hits = edge.cache_hit AND origin.missing. ETA 24 hours.
Priya Singh: Finance: mark invoice Jun for ClearSight as under review and issue provisional credit note $300 max. Create ticket FIN-5278.
Billing Bot: Ticket FIN-5278 created: ClearSight edge-cache returned 200s -> ingestion undercount.
Alejandra (Revenue Ops): label FIN-5278 "provisional-credit-applied". If final delta > $500 escalate to revenue director.
Victor Ramos: I'll pull edge logs now. If config was misapplied we should push a rule change to stop caching dynamic responses immediately.
Hannah Lee: Messaging to customer: "We've applied a provisional credit up to $300 while we reconcile logs with CloudEdge; ETA 2 business days."
Victor Ramos: noted. Will update when edge log join completes.
Hannah Lee: thanks all — FIN-5278 assigned to FinanceOps and Eng-Edge. :white_check_mark:
